picks.title: 鲸口脱险
picks.summary: 一场突如其来的意外，让他被巨鲸吞入腹中。受困于漆黑鲸腹之中，他仅剩 一小时氧气。在与时间赛跑、与恐惧正面交锋的同时，父亲留给他的技能，或许正是他逃出生天的唯一希望。
picks.summaryEn: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with

picks.title: 黑球
picks.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
picks.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

picks.title: 死亡幻觉
picks.summary: 一名问题少年在诡异地逃过一场离奇事故后，不断被一个穿着巨型兔子装的神秘男子幻象纠缠，并被操纵犯下一连串罪行。
picks.summaryEn: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

picks.title: 附带伤亡
picks.summary: 影片在夜晚的特拉维夫屋顶拍摄，揭示以色列在加沙对巴勒斯坦平民实施大规模杀戮背后的系统。
picks.summaryEn: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians

picks.title: 挖掘者
picks.summary: 世界上最有权势的男子极力证明自己其实是人类的救世主，结果等来了他酝酿的灾难要摧毁万物。
picks.summaryEn: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

picks.title: 另一个妈妈
picks.summary: 改编自乔什·马勒曼的小说《屋中异闻》。贝拉与父母生活在关系日渐紧张的家庭中。一天，一个与母亲长相相同的邪恶实体出现，并逐渐威胁到贝拉及其家人的安全。
picks.summaryEn: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.
